comment: Independent getpos.c object-cycle recipe: drop a scroll, wish for a rock and drop it on the scroll so the square shows the piletop rock glyph, then drop a second rock alone two squares west. Standing between them, the travel prompt cycles o, o, O. gather_locs_interesting() GLOC_OBJS compares the whole glyph with objnum_to_glyph(ROCK), so the lone rock is skipped while the piletop rock remains a target.
